title: Foundry Partners LLC Has $1.11 Million Position in Apple (AAPL)
text:
Posted by Jennifer Salazar on May 5th, 2018 // No Comments
Foundry Partners LLC lowered its holdings in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.1% in the 4th quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 6,542 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 350 shares during the quarter. Foundry Partners LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,107,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Several other institutional investors have also recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Oak Point Wealth Management purchased a new stake in Apple during the 4th quarter worth approximately $163,000. Interactive Financial Advisors purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at $188,000. Financial & Investment Management Group Ltd. purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the 4th quarter valued at $204,000. Hikari Power Ltd purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the 3rd quarter valued at $208,000. Finally, Eliot Finkel Investment Counsel LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the 3rd quarter valued at $209,000. 61.18% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. NASDAQ:AAPL traded up $6.94 during mid-day trading on Friday, hitting $183.83. The stock had a trading volume of 56,123,520 shares, compared to its average volume of 34,555,072. The stock has a market cap of $897,542.19, a price-to-earnings ratio of 19.96, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.31 and a beta of 1.26. Apple has a twelve month low of $142.20 and a twelve month high of $184.20. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.46 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $60.94 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The firm’s revenue was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the company earned $2.10 earnings per share. equities analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.43 EPS for the current year.
Apple announced that its board has authorized a share repurchase program on Tuesday, May 1st that authorizes the company to buyback $100.00 billion in outstanding shares. This buyback authorization authorizes the iPhone maker to buy up to 11.9% of its shares through open market purchases. Shares buyback programs are typically an indication that the company’s management believes its shares are undervalued.
The company also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, May 17th. Investors of record on Monday, May 14th will be issued a $0.73 dividend. This is a boost from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, May 11th. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.59%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is 27.36%.
In other Apple news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last ninety days, insiders sold 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201. 0.08% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders.
Several research firms have recently commented on AAPL. Atlantic Securities reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $185.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. DZ Bank reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday. Citigroup reaffirmed a “focus list” rating and issued a $142.20 price objective (up from $100.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. Zacks Investment Research raised shares of Apple from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Thursday. Finally, Canaccord Genuity upped their price objective on shares of Apple from $200.00 to $208.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company. The company currently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $204.00.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
